title: SWEOps-Bench: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Resolution of Software-Induced Cloud Incidents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06099v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As autonomous agents advance, the traditional boundary between software development and cloud operations gradually blurs, increasing the need for integrated incident detection, localization, and remediation. Existing benchmarks evaluate isolated diagnostic queries or repository-level program repair, failing to test continuous incident resolution across operational clusters and source repositories. We introduce SWEOps-Bench, an interactive benchmark comprising 55 reproducible incident tasks derived from confirmed historical defects across 16 Kubernetes operator projects. Each task preserves the original software repository and initializes in a healthy cluster before a controlled workload triggers the historical fault. Agents investigate runtime evidence and submit source or configuration repairs through a terminal interface, while the harness builds and deploys the changes within a shared time budget. translated_title: SWEOps-Bench：评估用于端到端解决软件引发云事故的智能体基准
translated_abstract: 随着自主智能体的不断进步，软件开发与云运维之间的传统边界逐渐模糊，对集成式事故检测、定位与修复能力的需求日益增长。现有基准仅评估孤立的诊断查询或仓库级程序修复，无法测试跨越运维集群和源代码仓库的持续性事故解决能力。我们提出了SWEOps-Bench，这是一个交互式基准，包含55个可复现的事故任务，这些任务源自16个Kubernetes operator项目中已确认的历史缺陷。每个任务保留原始软件仓库，并在受控工作负载触发历史故障之前以健康的集群状态初始化。智能体通过终端界面调查运行时证据，并提交源代码或配置修复，同时测试框架会在共享的时间预算内构建并部署这些更改。评估涵盖分阶段准确率……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了SWEOps-Bench，一个包含55个源自16个Kubernetes operator项目真实历史缺陷的可复现事故任务的交互式基准，用于评估智能体在统一时间预算内端到端完成云事故的检测、定位与修复的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SWEOps-Bench, an interactive benchmark of 55 reproducible incident tasks derived from confirmed historical defects across 16 Kubernetes operator projects, designed to evaluate agents' end-to-end capabilities in detecting, localizing, and remediating software-induced cloud incidents within a shared time budget.
